title: 静香馆 Jingxiang Guan
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 澡身浴德、福海
evidence.excerpt_zh: 澡身浴徳在福海西南隅即澄虛榭正宇三楹東嚮南為含清暉北為涵妙識折而西向為静香館又西為解愠書屋西南為曠然閣（圓明園册）臣等謹按福海亦稱東湖周廣凡數頃澡身浴徳四十景之一也額為皇上御書聫曰好雨知時岑巒添逺碧薰風叶奏殿閣有餘清亦御書
evidence.summary: In the south-west corner of 福海: 澡身浴徳, the three-bay 澄虛榭 facing east, with 含清暉, 涵妙識, 静香館, 解愠書屋 and 曠然閣. The note calls 福海 also 東湖 East Lake, several qing around.

evidence.title: 静香馆
evidence.locator: v2 p.341, under 澡身浴德; source ref 8-808
evidence.excerpt_zh: 回廊多曲折，闲馆致幽深。药蕊飘清馥，桐柯布翠阴。鱼飞常入镜，蝉韵自调琴。嗅复翳根静，云香何处寻。
evidence.summary: Poem 静香馆 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1764, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

evidence.title: 静香馆
evidence.locator: v2 p.343, under 澡身浴德; source ref 9-323
evidence.excerpt_zh: 曲廊偏有趣，闲馆致无华。可以消清暇，於焉味静嘉。砌花常递馥，林鸟亦非哗。新筍才抽叶，墙头几个斜。
evidence.summary: Poem 静香馆 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1767, filed by the editors under 澡身浴德.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
